description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, Governor Henry McMaster has declared a State of Emergency as a part of the State Emergency Response Team (SERT)’s preparations for severe weather anticipated from Thursday through Sunday in the Palmetto State. Some may be wondering why the South Carolina Emergency Management Division (SCEMD) recommended a State of Emergency for Hurricane Ian given that it will likely be a Tropical Storm by the time it impacts our State.
